audit.whatIsWrong: Prismatic Barrier and Illumination never appear anywhere on the full layer, and breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers.
audit.why: Prismatic Barrier is a 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s shield that absorbs the burst window you are paying mana for — the flagged shield-absorbs-burst interaction. Illumination is the other half of her damage: her spells charge the target and her NEXT ATTACK ignites it, so stepping out of auto range after eating a spell denies the proc. Light Binding is a flat 10s at every rank and binds up to two units, which is why a minion in front of you is a real block.
audit.corrected: Barrier, Illumination and the two-unit Q limit written into cooldowns, trading, loading, dosFull and report[5], with real numbers.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/W Riot text and cooldowns

notes: The content layer here is the best-written of my seven and needed almost nothing — only whys[1]'s 'her second ability' was replaced with the real name. The full layer was the templated half: Prismatic Barrier and Illumination appeared nowhere, breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers, and six of seven phases[N].side rows read 'Skill' against win[N] and the packet levelChart (Lux, Lux, Neeko, Lux, Skill, Neeko, Neeko). Sides moved to match win[N] with all seven whys rewritten in the same proposal. Ratings, tone, diff and carryRating untouched — EVEN at 5.5/10 fits a 55.2% win rate over 279 games and a chart that changes hands four times. The brief's missingInteraction calls Illumination an auto-attack RESET; Riot's text says her next attack ignites the charge for bonus damage and says nothing about resetting the attack timer, so I wrote the proc and not the reset. Lux's E carries a revealsStealth flag; Neeko's disguise is not stealth in Riot's text, so no claim was made about Lucent Singularity revealing a disguised Neeko. Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js). MISGENDER: the enemy is female and the full layer addressed her as male; every flagged field corrected in place. COPY_PASTE_BLEED: Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title were replaced with bodies that argue their own title, using kit numbers. COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE: rebuilt around real cooldowns and ranges from champ-data/_kits.
